Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Speech synthesis can change the distribution of human transcription errors and limit transfer from VoxDIY; the stringent industry QC pipeline also limits coverage of harder or lower-quality annotation settings.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

CrowdSpeech crowdsourced transcriptions of English LibriSpeech audio; VoxDIY synthesized Russian news text with Yandex SpeechKit before human transcription. Each recording was annotated by seven workers.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Workers self-reported the task language and took a ten-recording entrance exam requiring WER at most 40%; ongoing controls blocked repeated sub-ten-second tasks and poor recent gold-question WER. Attempted exams and pre-block completed tasks were compensated.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

On CrowdSpeech test-clean, Table 4 reports mean WER7.29 for ROVER versus 4.32 for a gold-aware oracle; on test-other the corresponding WERs are 13.41 and 8.50. The oracle selects the best submitted transcription and does not establish a general upper bound for methods that can edit text.
